title: Read function factories and repeated application
description: You follow closures and the supplied transformation helpers through their calls.

steps.description: You call make_adder with separate n values to create two closures, functions retaining an enclosing binding. The recorded calls print 8, 13, and 16.
You define compose and pipeline as helpers returning callable expressions. reduce is imported before the supplied pipeline is called.

steps.question: How many calls to add5 does add5_twice(0) make?
steps.answer: twice returns a function that evaluates f(f(x)), so it calls add5 twice. The recorded result is 10.
